about: The postcommunion of the Fourth Sunday of Advent. It asks for no new gift but that coming often to the same one make the fruit grow.

s01.translation: Having received these gifts, we beseech Thee, O Lord: that by the frequent celebration of the mystery the effect of our salvation may grow. Through our Lord.

w001.function: An ablative absolute: “the gifts having been received”. It stands apart from the clause beside it.
